capabilities: Remove cite markers and 【...†...】 citation blocks from notes
Replace entity and url markers with their readable labels
Clean the whole active note or only the current selection via commands
Batch-process .md files in a vault directory from the command line
Preserve YAML frontmatter, fenced code blocks, and inline code
disambiguation: Not a general Markdown formatter; it only removes Deep Research marker tokens and applies minimal whitespace cleanup.
extras: The two command names are listed in Chinese in the README. Building from source requires Node.js 20+, npm 10+, and Obsidian 1.5.0+; install is manual by copying files into the plugins folder. A standalone CLI (dist/cli.js) is included for batch cleaning outside Obsidian.
problem: ChatGPT Deep Research exports contain inline private-use markers and 【...†...】 citation blocks that are noisy or unreadable in plain Markdown in Obsidian.

relations.evidence: an Obsidian plugin for cleaning Markdown exported from ChatGPT Deep Research

summary: Marker cleaner that removes ChatGPT Deep Research citation, entity, and URL tokens from exported Markdown notes.
